values.quote: Each stack reduces the target's {{sti|ar|{{as|armor}}}} and {{sti|mr|{{as|magic resistance}}}} by 3% for a maximum of 15% reduction

values.meaning: minimum flat reduction per stack (scales by level, 20 levels of data but champion max level 18)
values.quote: reduce the target's {{as|armor}} and {{as|magic resistance}} by a minimum of {{pp|1.5 + (3-1.5)/17*(x-1) for 20}}

mechanics.claim: Rell gains bonus armor and magic resist equal to the sum of resistances reduced from all afflicted enemies.
mechanics.quote: '''Rell''' gains {{as|'''bonus''' armor}} and {{as|'''bonus''' magic resistance}} equal to the sum of resistances reduced from all afflicted enemies.

mechanics.claim: Basic attacks on-hit and abilities against non-minions apply a stack, refreshing duration on subsequent hits.
mechanics.quote: apply a {{tip|stack}} of ''Break The Mold'' for 5 seconds, refreshing on subsequent hits and stacking up to 5 times

mechanics.claim: The first stack snapshots the target's current armor and MR; later stacks reduce based on that snapshot until the debuff expires.
mechanics.quote: The first stack of ''Break the Mold'' that is applied to a target will snapshot the targets current {{sti|ar|{{as|armor}}}} and {{sti|mr|{{as|magic resistance}}}}. All subsequent stacks will reduce the targets resistances based on the snapshotted amount

mechanics.claim: The bonus on-hit magic damage does not affect structures.
